purpose: Make the preregistered same-plate expanding reference bank duplication-safe across overlapping tile sections without changing the strict reference filters or minimum reference count.

dedup_contract.precondition: only detections passing the frozen strict reference-star filters enter the duplicate graph
dedup_contract.natural_cell_assignment: convert each detection centroid to full-plate pixel coordinates and assign it to the nearest of the 49 frozen grid centres; exact-distance ties resolve by lexicographic tile_id
dedup_contract.duplicate_graph: within each natural grid cell, connect strict-reference detections whose pass2 sky-coordinate separation is <=2.0 arcsec; connected components define one physical-reference candidate
representative_rule: prefer a detection measured in the same tile_id as its assigned natural grid cell
dedup_contract.target_exclusion: for each normalized target, exclude every reference component whose representative sky coordinate lies <=2.0 arcsec from the recovered target pass2 coordinate
dedup_contract.support_count: count deduplicated reference components, never raw overlapping-tile detections
dedup_contract.conservative_boundary: A 2 arcsec merge can under-count very close stellar pairs; under-count is preferred to duplicate inflation for this engineering gate.

unchanged_contract.normalization: median + 1.4826*MAD; finite positive robust sigma required
